Veeam.title: Outage, Attack, or AI Agent Drift: Lessons from the Microsoft 365 Outage
Veeam.summary: On Thursday, Nov. 12, Microsoft 365 went dark for much of the world. Problems started with Exchange Online around 11:20 a.m. ET, then spread to Teams, SharePoint, Copilot, and even Defender XDR. Outage reports came in from 74 countries and territories, and, by Microsoft's own incident record, the disruption ran just shy of 24 hours. The post Outage, Attack, or AI Agent Drift: Lessons from the Microsoft 365 Outage appeared first on Veeam Software Official Blog .

Cisco.title: Vulnerability in Oracle OpenJDK (Java4Shell) Affecting Cisco Products: November 2026
Cisco.summary: On November 17, 2026, Oracle announced the availability of fixes for a vulnerability in OpenJDK that could lead to remote code execution identified by CVE-2026-114938. The vulnerability affects OpenJDK Java 17.0.6 and later on x86-64 platforms when processing Base64 encoded content.  For more information, see the Oracle Critical Security Patch Update Advisory - November 2026 and the OpenJDK Vulnerability Advisory: 2026/11/17 . On Nov 25, 2025, AWS introduced Network Firewall proxy in public preview to help customers exert centralized security controls against data exfiltration and malware injection.
